scripts.build: pnpm --filter @chronelle/schemas build && pnpm --filter @chronelle/authorization build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @chronelle/schemas build && pnpm --filter @chronelle/authorization build && tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @chronelle/schemas build && pnpm --filter @chronelle/authorization build && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @chronelle/schemas build && pnpm --filter @chronelle/authorization build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
